name: After School Girlfriend: Performing Arts Club!
source:
Souin High School’s performing arts club is on the brink of disbandment and you’ve been roped into helping them gather more members.

[From [url=https://twitter.com/GeniusBishoujo/status/1500093861745549312?s=20&t=7sljkuwCRMbHa_q_aEPXMQ]official Twitter[/url]]
translation:
Souin高中的表演艺术社濒临解散，你也被拉来帮忙，招募更多社员。

[摘自[url=https://twitter.com/GeniusBishoujo/status/1500093861745549312?s=20&t=7sljkuwCRMbHa_q_aEPXMQ]官方推特[/url]]
